The '''Tungra sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]].

==History==
It was here that the [[Mugaari]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] maintained a cargo loading area, at which they conducted a secret deal with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The meeting was interrupted by the arrival of the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Modified Frigate]] ''[[Fogger]]'' and its complement of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].
